headlines.title: Canada Prepares to Retaliate on Trump's 50% Tariffs
headlines.description: After President Donald Trump imposed 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods, Canada is saying it has leverage. “We have what the world wants,” Prime Minister Mark Carney said. Meanwhile, Trump’s pressure campaign on Iran is underway with what he calls “economic D-Day,” slapping fresh sanctions on 60 foreign entities and threatening to cut off countries unless they stop doing business with Iran. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Supreme Court hands preliminary win to Trump on mail-in ballots executive order
headlines.description: The Trump administration wants to exert greater control over mail-in ballots ahead of the midterms despite the primary role states play in overseeing elections.

headlines.title: The opposing narratives in the Lindsay Clancy trial
headlines.description: At the center of a case that is gripping the nation stands the question: Is Lindsay Clancy criminally responsible for killing her three children? The prosecution and defense made clear the competing narratives they would present to the jury in their opening statements. Misty Marris and Steven Romo analyze what each side wanted jurors to believe before the first witness ever took the stand.

headlines.title: People in Gary, Indiana without power for 13 days
headlines.description: For almost two weeks, residents in Gary, IN have been without power following destructive storms and tornadoes that tore through the region on August 11. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster reports from Gary.

headlines.title: Send in your questions on China, AI and robotics for Janis Mackey Frayer
headlines.description: NBC News’ correspondent, who has spent years in China, will answer reader questions in a Q&A for subscribers on Tuesday.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze results from South Carolina's GOP Senate runoff
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from South Carolina's GOP Senate runoff between Darline Graham and Ralph Norman, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: One-in-four NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had CTE, study shows
headlines.description: At least one in four former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 was found to have had chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), according to a study released on Tuesday.

headlines.title: Iran vows retaliation after U.S. widens sanctions, fueling fears of escalated war
headlines.description: TEHRAN, Iran — Iran has vowed to retaliate against to widened U.S. sanctions, saying Washington should “expect an attack” in response to the measures.

headlines.title: Mystery as U.S. military transport plane lands in Moscow
headlines.description: Mystery swirled around a U.S. military transport aircraft that on Tuesday landed in Moscow, according to tracking data.

headlines.title: Multiple dead, including children, in Montana shooting and house fire
headlines.description: A motive in the incident in Billings wasn’t immediately provided. Police said they were withholding the identities of the dead for now.

headlines.title: ‘Getting no help’: Thousands in Gary, Indiana, still without power nearly 2 weeks after storms
headlines.description: For some in the predominantly Black city, the lack of electricity has caused medical complications, while others are cooking what food they can at local parks before it spoils.

headlines.title: The best end-of-summer sales to shop now: Birkenstock, J.Crew, Le Creuset and more
headlines.description: With summer almost over, brands like Birkenstock, J.Crew, Stanley and more are having end-of-summer sales with deals of up to 75% off on apparel and more.
